mentions.name: Personal agent harness voice assistant
mentions.description: A small self-built agent harness running at home as a personal assistant, built mainly to learn how agent harnesses work. It already supports voice-set kitchen timers — saying something like "set a 10 minute timer for the pasta" starts a named timer that announces "ding! Pasta timer" when it expires, with support for many concurrent named timers — controlled via a web app on a phone. The goal is to add better hardware (a Raspberry Pi) and wake-word support for a fully hands-free kitchen/cooking-oriented voice assistant.
mentions.problem: The current phone web app can't easily support wake-word activation without hacking, and better hardware is needed for hands-free use while cooking.
mentions.audience: Explicitly for the author's own personal use as a home personal assistant.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on small agent harness at home for a personal assistant. In spirit it’s similar to OpenClaw or Hermes Agent but I’m mostly using it for learning about agent harnesses to get a better understanding of the ecosystem.
